title: Règles officielles du marché
text:
This market refers to the Dota 2 Lower Bracket Final match between LenS Team and iLTW TEAM in the Media Eleague Playoffs, initially scheduled for November 11, 2026 at 7:00 AM ET.

This market will resolve to "LenS Team" if LenS Team win Game 1 against iLTW TEAM.

This market will resolve to "iLTW TEAM" if iLTW TEAM win Game 1 against LenS Team.

If the match begins but is not completed, and Game 1 is concluded with a winner determined, this market will resolve based on the completed Game 1. 

If Game 1 is not completed for any reason, this market will resolve 50-50. 

If the match is canceled (not played at all), this market will resolve 50-50.

If the match is postponed, it must be rescheduled to a start time on or before November 25, 2026 at 11:59 PM ET (14 calendar days after the originally scheduled start of November 11, 2026 at 7:00 AM ET). If, by that deadline, the most recently announced rescheduled start time is on or before the deadline, this market resolves based on the result of the match as played. Otherwise, this market resolves 50-50, regardless of whether the match is subsequently played.

The resolution source for this market will be official information from https://www.dotabuff.com. However, if https://www.dotabuff.com has not published final results within 2 hours after the event’s conclusion, a consensus of credible reporting may be used instead including video evidence.
